name: ArenaStepperStep
description: One step of an ArenaStepper. Whether it is complete, current or upcoming is not a field: the stepper derives it from its `index`, so two current steps cannot be written.

description.description: A line under the label, in the muted ink.

error.description: Whether the step needs attention. Position cannot say it, so a step ahead of the current one can carry it. Drawn as a danger outline with a warning glyph and spoken as a word.
